title: Deductible Carry in the Insurance Claim Services Dwelling Release
content:
**Rule.** For the insured's dwelling release on an Insurance Claim Services file, the deductible carry is set as follows: when the ACV carrier payments on the dwelling coverage are at least the initial dwelling approval less its depreciation withheld, the whole deductible; when they fall short of that figure by less than the deductible, the deductible less that shortfall; otherwise nothing.

Records: the carrier's initial scope approval on the dwelling coverage and the depreciation withheld on it, the ACV carrier payments received on the dwelling coverage, and the deductible recorded on the claim file.

## Three outcomes

| ACV dwelling payments compared with initial dwelling approval less its withheld depreciation | Deductible carry |
|---|---|
| equal or more | the whole deductible |
| short by less than the deductible | the deductible less the shortfall |
| short by the deductible or more | nothing |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical: initial dwelling approval 31000.00, withheld 4200.00, so 26800.00; deductible 1750.00)

- ACV payments 26800.00: whole deductible, 1750.00.
- ACV payments 26350.00: short by 450.00, carry 1300.00.
- ACV payments 25050.00: short by exactly 1750.00, carry nothing.
